rumor_yosef.title: A preacher at the Jordan
rumor_yosef.source: Yosef, a trader on the roads
rumor_yosef.text: Yosef the trader says a man named John is preaching beside the river Jordan, crying that people must repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand. Crowds are walking out from Jerusalem and all Judaea to hear him, and those who confess their sins are baptized in the river. I have only Yosef's word for it.

testimony_hannah.title: Hannah has seen John
testimony_hannah.source: Hannah, a traveler from the south
testimony_hannah.text: Hannah, resting by the east road, has seen the preacher herself. She says John wears a garment of camel's hair with a leather girdle about his loins, and that it is said he eats locusts and wild honey. Hundreds go down into the Jordan confessing their sins. She did not stay long, but she has not stopped thinking about it.

testimony_ezra.title: Elder Ezra: the voice in the wilderness
testimony_ezra.text: Elder Ezra says the preacher's words put him in mind of the prophet Isaiah: 'The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD.' He would not say what it means, only that I should go with open eyes, if I go, and tell him what I see.

q_who_is_john.title: Who is John, and what is coming?
q_who_is_john.text: Everyone speaks as though something is about to happen. 'The kingdom of heaven is at hand.' What kingdom? Whose? I do not know, and I find I cannot leave it alone.

obs_decision.title: The road east
obs_decision.text: At the east edge of the village, the road drops away toward the Jordan valley. I have heard enough from others. I want to see it with my own eyes.

obs_ezra_sword.title: Ezra's sword
obs_ezra_sword.text: Before I set out, Elder Ezra pressed his old sword into my hands. He said the road to the Jordan is long and not everyone on it is honest. He told me to keep it sheathed unless I must, for a sword answers a danger but does not answer a question. I do not know yet whether I will be glad to have it.

q_look_backward.title: What was written before?
q_look_backward.text: Ezra says that when something strange happens, he asks what was written before it. He wants me to bring him any old scroll I find, and he will read it to me. What it means, he says, he will leave to me.
